description: Source file defining a PhrasebookService module that provides in-memory phrase data, category listing, language listing, and phrase filtering functions for a multilingual travel guide application.

methods.name: listLanguages
methods.description: Generates a list of supported languages based on dictionaries.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Returns the predefined list of phrase categories.

methods.name: listPhrases
methods.description: Filters and returns phrases based on language, category, and search query.

methods.name: listAvailableLanguages
methods.description: Returns list of supported languages derived from dictionaries.

methods.name: getFeaturedPhrases
methods.description: Returns a small set of phrases to feature on the Language Hub.
